latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Strategic Commitment Designer skill.

- Helps users design credible strategic moves — commitments, threats, and promises — to influence counterpart behavior before play begins.
- Guides users to classify their move (deterrence vs. compellence; commitment, threat, or promise) and select appropriate credibility mechanisms.
- Covers the full taxonomy of strategic moves and all eight credibility mechanisms for making threats/promises believable.
- Suited for negotiators, policymakers, executives, and anyone needing to make a stance credible, deter/compel action, or structure robust incentive mechanisms.
- Requires an underlying game analysis (from backward-reasoning-game-solver) before use; does not include game tree solving itself.
